standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation of a finitely generated field extension as the fraction field of a global complete intersection
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4498-4501)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the auxiliary algebra over which the base change is a relative global complete intersection.

standard_prerequisites.name: The permanence of the complete intersection property under a relative global complete intersection
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4502-4504 and 4519-4520)
standard_prerequisites.use: Carries the property through the base change and through the regular extension in part (C).

core_obligations: Part (A): for a finitely generated field extension present it as the fraction field of a global complete intersection and use permanence of the property under the induced relative global complete intersection (proof lines 4496-4504)
Part (B): the property is local, so it holds for a ring exactly when it holds for all its local rings (proof lines 4507-4509)

Part (C) and (D): after assuming the base is a field and the extension is a regular local homomorphism, one fibre is a complete intersection and the other is regular, hence a complete intersection, and the two directions of the same permanence statement give the two parts (proof lines 4512-4525)
Part (E): the condition does not mention the ground field (proof lines 4526)
proof_roadmap: (A)：把有限生成扩张 K/k 写成整体完全交 A = k[x]/(f) 的分式域；R → R ⊗_k A 是相对整体完全交 ⇒ 由 Avramov 引理 R ⊗_k A 是局部完全交。
(B)：局部完全交当且仅当各局部环是完全交，逐局部验证即可。
(C)(D)：化为 k 是域、B → C 是正则局部同态；此时 B 与 C/m_B C 都是完全交，再用 Avramov 引理的另一个方向（(D) 同法），(E) 与基域无关，显然。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement verifies, for the property of being a local complete intersection, the five permanence properties (A) through (E) of the formal fibres section (author lemma at source lines 4487-4493, label lemma-formal-fibres-lci). The proof (source lines 4495-4528) handles (A) by presenting the field extension as the fraction field of a global complete intersection and applying permanence under the resulting relative global complete intersection, (B) by locality of the property, (C) and (D) by reducing to a regular local homomorphism whose two sides are complete intersections and using the two directions of the same permanence statement, and (E) because the condition does not refer to the ground field (proof lines 4522-4527). Parts (A) and (C) are the substance. H3.
